info.title: Dayli API
info.description: REST API shared by the Dayli mobile and web clients.

cookieAuth.name: better-auth.session_token
cookieAuth.description: Browser clients may authenticate with the Better Auth secure session cookie.

audience.description: `solo` appears only on the caller's own profile.

released.description: False only on the caller's own profile, for a post whose day has not been released yet.

edited.description: True when the author has edited the post since it was accepted.

media.description: Attached photos or video in display order, each with a private download URL that expires after 5 minutes.

ProfilePost.description: One post on a profile. Tomorrow notes are not part of this projection.

url.description: A private download URL that expires at expiresAt. When media storage is unavailable, a response that would include media is a 503 instead.

expiresAt.description: When a signed private URL stops working. Null for a Worker URL that reauthorizes every request.

RestrictedProfilePosts.description: The complete archive response for a private account when the caller is neither its owner nor an active friend.

avatarUrl.description: The parent-authorized Worker avatar route when a current avatar exists, otherwise null.

PublicProfile.description: The anonymous-safe basics for a public account.

current.description: Consecutive Auckland days with an accepted post, ending today, or yesterday while today is still open.

allOf.description: The Auckland day the values were calculated for. They hold until that day's midnight unless a post is accepted or deleted.

PostingStreak.description: Null whenever the bio is hidden. Solo and friends posts both count; drafts and failed submissions do not.

RestrictedProfile.description: The complete response for a private account when the caller is neither its owner nor an active friend.

message.example: The request could not be completed.

tomorrowNote.description: Present when a tomorrow note was submitted; its text is readable from availableOn.

media.description: The attached photos or video in display order. Empty for a text-only post.

voiceMemo.description: The attached voice memo, or null when the post has none.

allOf.description: The Auckland day the draft was written for. It must still be the server's current day when the post is accepted.
The prompt ID returned by GET /api/v1/posting-days/current for localDate.

reflectiveAnswer.example: Walked to the harbour after class.

tomorrowNote.description: An author-only note that becomes readable on the following Auckland day. It is never echoed back.

attachments.description: Validated media reservation IDs from POST /api/v1/media-reservations, in display order. Up to 3 photos or 1 video, never both, plus at most 1 voice memo, up to 25 MB in total. Omit it or send an empty list for a text-only post.

allOf.description: The Auckland day the page shows: yesterday, released at the most recent midnight.

audience.description: Always `friends`: solo posts never appear in another user's feed.

edited.description: True when the author has edited the post since it was accepted.

media.description: Attached photos or video in display order, each with a private download URL that expires after 5 minutes.

FeedPost.description: A released post from an active friend. Tomorrow notes are not part of the feed projection.

edited.description: True when the caller can read an earlier version of the post.

revisionCount.description: Earlier versions the caller can read. The author sees every saved edit and sends this as `expectedRevisionCount` when editing. Anyone else sees only versions that were already shared with friends.

commentCount.description: Comments and replies the caller can see, leaving out deleted ones and people across a block.

media.description: Attached photos or video in display order, each with a private download URL that expires after 5 minutes.

voiceMemo.description: The post's voice memo with a private download URL that expires after 5 minutes, or null when the post has none. Only post detail carries it; feeds and profile lists do not.

PostDetail.description: One post the caller may read, including an anonymously readable public-profile post. Tomorrow notes are not part of this projection.

PostDetailPrompt.description: The prompt stored with the post, not the current day's prompt.

url.description: A private download URL that expires at expiresAt. When media storage is unavailable, a response that would include a voice memo is a 503 instead.

expiresAt.description: When a signed private URL stops working. Null for a Worker URL that reauthorizes every request.

ReadableProfilePosts.description: A restricted response has only kind and username. An archive response has kind and every ProfilePostsPage field.

allOf.description: Today's Auckland date, chosen by the server.

items.description: At most one memory per earlier year, newest year first.

allOf.description: The Auckland day the post was written for.

yearsAgo.description: Whole years between the post's Auckland day and today.

audience.description: Who could read the post. Memories are owner-only either way; this labels the original audience.

edited.description: True when the author has edited the post since it was accepted.

media.description: Attached photos or video in display order, each with a private download URL that expires after 5 minutes.

OnThisDayMemory.description: One of the caller's own earlier posts. Tomorrow notes are not part of this projection.

expectedRevisionCount.description: The `revisionCount` of the post the author last read. If another edit has been saved since, the request is a 409.

reflectiveAnswer.example: Walked to the harbour after class, then home along the beach.

UpdatePostRequest.description: Every editable field, as the post should read after the edit. Only values that differ are saved, and only then is a revision stored. The prompt, day, media and tomorrow note cannot be edited.

PostRevision.description: An earlier version of a post, which an edit replaced at `replacedAt`. The prompt, day and media are the same as the current post.

PostCommentsPage.description: Comments and replies in the order they were written. A reply always comes after its top-level comment, so clients group replies under it as pages arrive.

allOf.description: The top-level comment this replies to. Replies go one level deep.

viewerCanDelete.description: True for the comment's author and the post's author.

clientCommentId.description: A client-generated ID, such as a UUID, reused for every retry of this comment. A retry returns the comment already made.

parentCommentId.description: Replies to this top-level comment on the same post. Leave it out, or send null, for a top-level comment. Replies to replies are not allowed.

FutureSelfNote.description: A note to your future self, without its text.

FutureSelfNoteStatus.description: `scheduled` until the delivery job records the note as delivered. A scheduled note becomes readable on its Auckland date even before the job has run.

body.description: The note text, trimmed, 1 to 1,000 characters. It is never readable before its delivery date.
body.example: I hope the thesis is submitted and you slept well.

allOf.description: The Auckland calendar date the note is delivered on. When creating or rescheduling it must be from tomorrow (Auckland, decided by the server) up to 10 years after today.

body.description: The note text. Present only on or after deliverOn.

FutureSelfNoteDetail.description: A note to your future self whose date has arrived, with its text.

posts.description: Accepted posts, solo ones included; the streak already reveals which days had one.

ProfileStats.description: Null whenever the bio is hidden.

allOf.description: When the username can next change, or null when it can change now.

ProfileOwnerSettings.description: Present only on the caller's own profile.

ProfileVisibility.description: `private` shows the bio and streak to active friends only. Posts are always friends only.

username.description: The current handle. It differs from the requested one when that was a handle the owner has since changed.

detailsVisible.description: False when the account is private and the caller is not an active friend. The bio is then null.

whatIDo.description: Null when unset or when the bio is hidden.

listeningTo.description: Null when unset or when the bio is hidden.

avatarUrl.description: A link to the profile photo that expires after 10 minutes. Null when there is no photo or the bio is hidden.

ProfileDetails.description: The full profile projection returned only to the owner or an active friend.

publicName.description: The name shown instead of the username. Null or blank shows the username.

mbti.description: One of the 16 types. Null or blank clears it.

allOf.description: A validated upload from `POST /api/v1/media-reservations` of a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.

Exercise common API contracts

200.description: Representative date, time, and pagination values.

get.summary: Read the authenticated account's deletion status
get.description: Content-free state and database-timed deadlines. An absent lifecycle record is active.

403.description: Account policy denies the read.

post.summary: Request deletion after fresh action verification
post.description: Requires a session-bound single-use grant and Idempotency-Key header. Production requests remain disabled until a separate activation decision. This operation does not physically purge content.

200.description: The same pending request already exists.

201.description: Request recorded and ordinary sessions revoked.

403.description: Account policy or the action proof denies this request.

409.description: The lifecycle already has a different request or is irreversible.

422.description: Malformed action grant or idempotency key.

503.description: Requests are disabled or temporarily unavailable.

post.summary: Cancel a pending deletion after fresh action verification
post.description: Uses the database cancellation deadline. Revoked sessions and push registrations are not restored.

403.description: Account policy or the action proof denies cancellation.

409.description: No pending request exists or the cancellation deadline has passed.

get.summary: Read the owner's export request state

403.description: Account policy denies this read.

post.summary: Request one private account export

403.description: Account policy denies this request.

get.summary: Download a ready export through a fresh authenticated stream

403.description: Account policy denies this download.

404.description: No ready export exists for this session.

post.summary: Verify a password for one account management action
post.description: Issues a session-bound, single-use five-minute grant. This does not request or cancel deletion. Google-only accounts require a separate verified Google action.

403.description: Account policy denies the action.

409.description: The account has no password or its lifecycle changed.

429.description: The actor's reauthentication rate limit was reached.

503.description: Verification or rate limiting is temporarily unavailable.

post.summary: Start browser Google verification for one account action
post.description: A browser-only authorization-code flow. It does not sign in, link an account, or request deletion. The callback requires the original live session and a fresh signed Google authentication time.

200.description: Google authorization URL for the current session.

403.description: Account policy denies this action.

409.description: No linked Google account or the account state changed.

503.description: Google proof or rate limiting is temporarily unavailable.

post.summary: Record an explicit current Terms and 16+ action
post.description: Available only for an effective Terms version. The Privacy Policy is a notice, not consent. No draft document can be accepted.

200.description: The server-recorded Terms and age declaration timestamps.

403.description: The account cannot accept Terms in its current state.

409.description: The requested Terms are stale or no Terms are effective.

422.description: Explicit confirmation and an exact current Terms digest are required.

get.summary: Read current published signup Terms metadata

200.description: Draft documents are not available for acceptance. The response has no private data.

503.description: The legal version cannot be verified.

post.summary: Start one explicit email or Google registration action
post.description: Requires current approved documents and one affirmative Terms, Privacy notice, and 16+ action before account creation.

409.description: No current approved Terms or the selected version changed.

422.description: Explicit acceptance and a valid flow are required.

503.description: The legal version cannot be verified.

The owner's global mobile notification preference.

503.description: Media reservations are not currently configured.

404.description: No reservation with that id owned by the caller.

503.description: Media reservations are not currently configured.

200.description: The reservation's settled state — validated, failed with a reason, or still pending (not yet uploaded, retryable).

409.description: The reservation's TTL expired before it was ever completed.

get.summary: Read the current Auckland posting day

200.description: The server-owned current posting day and scheduled prompt.

503.description: The prompt or posting-state dependency is temporarily unavailable.

post.summary: Submit today's daily post
post.description: Creates the authenticated user's one post for the current Auckland day. Retry a lost response with the same `Idempotency-Key`: an identical retry returns the original post with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`, even after the deadline, while a changed request conflicts.

schema.description: A client-generated key reused for every retry of this submission, such as a UUID stored with the draft.

parameters.description: A client-generated key reused for every retry of this submission, such as a UUID stored with the draft.
parameters.name: idempotency-key

201.description: The accepted post, or the original post for an identical retry.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present and `true` when this response replays an earlier accepted request.

403.description: Posting is unavailable while account deletion is pending.

409.description: The posting day has closed or not yet opened, the prompt no longer matches, a post already exists for the day, the idempotency key was used for a different request, the post from an earlier submission with this key is in Trash (`POST_TRASHED`), an attachment is still uploading (`MEDIA_NOT_READY`), or an attachment can't be used and must be uploaded again (`MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE`). `details.reason` identifies which.

422.description: The request contains invalid values. `details.reason` is `MEDIA_NOT_ALLOWED` when the attachments mix photos and a video, include more than one video, or exceed 25 MB in total.

get.summary: List yesterday's posts from friends
get.description: Returns yesterday's `friends` posts by the authenticated user's active friends: the Auckland day released at the most recent midnight. Earlier days are on each friend's profile. Solo posts, the caller's own posts, and posts by blocked or blocking users are never included. Access is re-checked on every page.

409.description: The cursor is from an earlier feed day, for example a page loaded before midnight (`details.reason = "feedDayChanged"`, with the current `details.feedDate`). Start again without a cursor.

422.description: The query contains invalid values, including an unrecognised cursor.

503.description: The feed is temporarily unavailable, or the page has media and media storage is unavailable.

get.summary: List the authenticated owner's trashed posts

503.description: Post Trash is disabled or unavailable.

post.summary: Move an owned post to Trash

404.description: Post not found.

409.description: Post cannot be moved to Trash.

503.description: Post Trash is disabled or unavailable.

post.summary: Restore an owned post from Trash

404.description: Post not found.

409.description: Post cannot be restored.

503.description: Post Trash is disabled or unavailable.

get.summary: Read one post
get.description: Returns a post the caller may read. Authors can read their own solo and unreleased posts. Released `friends` posts are also readable by active friends and by anyone when the author has a public profile. A known signed-in block is denied before public-profile access. A missing post and a post the caller may not read both return 404.

401.description: Presented credentials are invalid or expired.

404.description: The post does not exist or the caller may not read it. The two cases are indistinguishable.

503.description: Post or media storage is temporarily unavailable.

patch.description: Lets the author change the reflective answer, caption, rating, and audience of their post, before or after release. The request carries all four, and only values that differ are saved. Each saved edit keeps the previous version as a revision. Send the `revisionCount` you last read as `expectedRevisionCount`; a 409 means another edit was saved first. Repeating an edit that is already saved returns the post without adding a revision.

200.description: The post as it is now.

404.description: The post does not exist, was deleted, or belongs to someone else. The cases are indistinguishable.

409.description: Another edit was saved after the caller read the post. Read it again and reapply the change.

422.description: The post ID or a field is invalid, or a field is missing.

503.description: Post storage is temporarily unavailable, or the post has media and media storage is unavailable.

get.summary: List the posts on a profile
get.description: Returns one person's posts, newest Auckland day first. Owners retain solo and unreleased posts. Active friends and public-profile readers receive released `friends` posts. A private non-friend receives only the username and a generic restricted state, with no page metadata. Access is re-checked on every page. Unknown, inactive, banned, and blocked profiles all return 404.

200.description: One page of the profile's posts.

404.description: The profile does not exist or is blocked in either direction. The cases are indistinguishable.

422.description: The username or query contains invalid values, including an unrecognised cursor.

503.description: Post storage is temporarily unavailable, or the page has media and media storage is unavailable.

get.summary: Read currently authorized post media bytes
get.description: Rechecks the current post and attachment on every request, then streams the private object without exposing a provider URL or object key.

304.description: The authorized representation has not changed.

404.description: The media is absent, detached, or its current parent is not readable.

412.description: An authorized conditional request precondition failed. The response has no provider body.

416.description: The requested byte range is not satisfiable. The response has no provider body.

get.summary: Read currently authorized voice memo bytes
get.description: Rechecks the current post and attachment on every request, then streams the private object without exposing a provider URL or object key.

206.description: The requested voice memo byte range.

304.description: The authorized representation has not changed.

404.description: The voice memo is absent, detached, or its current parent is not readable.

412.description: An authorized conditional request precondition failed. The response has no provider body.

416.description: The requested byte range is not satisfiable. The response has no provider body.

get.summary: Get a fresh download URL for one attached photo or video
get.description: Returns a new private download URL, valid for 5 minutes, when an earlier one has expired. The same rules as reading the post apply, and the media must still be attached to it.

200.description: The media with a fresh download URL.

404.description: The media is missing, detached, or on a post the caller may not read. These cases are not distinguished.

503.description: Post or media storage is temporarily unavailable.

get.summary: Get a fresh download URL for a post's voice memo
get.description: Returns a new private download URL, valid for 5 minutes, when an earlier one has expired. The same rules as reading the post apply, and the voice memo must still be attached to it.

200.description: The voice memo with a fresh download URL.

404.description: The post has no voice memo, or the caller may not read the post. These cases are not distinguished.

503.description: Post or media storage is temporarily unavailable.

get.summary: List the caller's On This Day memories
get.description: Returns the caller's own posts from today's Auckland month and day in earlier years, newest year first, at most one per year. Only the caller's posts are ever returned, solo and friends alike. Posts in Trash or awaiting purge, and posts from the current year, are left out. A 29 February post is a memory only on 29 February of a later leap year. The date is the server's current Auckland date and cannot be supplied by the client.

403.description: The caller has not chosen a username yet.

503.description: Post storage is temporarily unavailable, or a memory has media and media storage is unavailable.

get.summary: List a post's earlier versions
get.description: Returns earlier versions of a post the caller may read, newest first. The author sees every version. Anyone else sees only versions that were already shared with friends, so text written while the post was solo stays private. A missing post and a post the caller may not read both return 404.

404.description: The post does not exist or the caller may not read it. The two cases are indistinguishable.

422.description: The post ID or query contains invalid values, including an unrecognised cursor.

put.description: Likes a post the caller may read, including their own. Liking a post already liked changes nothing, so retries are safe. Returns the like count and whether the caller likes it.

200.description: The post's like count and whether the caller likes it.

403.description: The caller hasn't chosen a username yet.

404.description: The post does not exist or the caller may not read it. The two cases are indistinguishable.

delete.description: Removes the caller's like from a post they may read. Unliking a post that isn't liked changes nothing, so retries are safe. Returns the like count and whether the caller likes it.

200.description: The post's like count and whether the caller likes it.

403.description: The caller hasn't chosen a username yet.

404.description: The post does not exist or the caller may not read it. The two cases are indistinguishable.

get.summary: List who liked a post
get.description: Returns the people who liked a post the caller may read, newest first. People the caller has blocked, or who blocked the caller, are left out.

403.description: The caller hasn't chosen a username yet.

404.description: The post does not exist or the caller may not read it. The two cases are indistinguishable.

get.summary: List the comments on a post
get.description: Returns comments and replies on a post the caller may read, oldest first. Deleted comments, replies under a deleted comment, and comments by people across a block from the caller are left out. Each comment says whether the caller may edit or delete it.

200.description: One page of comments and replies.

403.description: The caller hasn't chosen a username yet.

404.description: The post does not exist or the caller may not read it. The two cases are indistinguishable.

post.summary: Comment on a post
post.description: Adds a comment, or a reply to a top-level comment, on a post the caller may read. Replies go one level deep. A retry with the same `clientCommentId` returns the comment already made with 200.

200.description: A retry of a comment already made.

403.description: The caller hasn't chosen a username yet.

404.description: The post does not exist or the caller may not read it. The two cases are indistinguishable.

409.description: The `clientCommentId` was already used for a different comment.

422.description: The text is invalid, or `parentCommentId` is not a visible top-level comment on this post.

patch.description: Lets the commenter change their comment while they can still read the post. The comment is then marked edited. Anyone else's comment returns 404.

200.description: The comment as it is now.

403.description: The caller hasn't chosen a username yet.

404.description: The post or comment does not exist, or the caller may not read or change it. The cases are indistinguishable.

delete.description: Lets the commenter, or the post's author, delete a comment. Deleting a top-level comment also hides its replies. Deleting a comment that is already deleted also returns 204.

403.description: The caller hasn't chosen a username yet.

404.description: The post or comment does not exist, or the caller may not read or change it. The cases are indistinguishable.

post.summary: Write a note to your future self
post.description: Schedules an owner-only note for an Auckland date from tomorrow up to 10 years ahead. The note is not attached to a post. Its text is never readable, even by you, before that date. Retry a lost response with the same `Idempotency-Key`: an identical retry returns the original note with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`, while a changed request conflicts. Requires a chosen username.

schema.description: A client-generated key reused for every retry of this note, such as a UUID stored with the draft.

parameters.description: A client-generated key reused for every retry of this note, such as a UUID stored with the draft.
parameters.name: idempotency-key

201.description: The scheduled note without its text, or the original note for an identical retry.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present and `true` when this response replays an earlier accepted request.

403.description: The account has not chosen a username (`details.reason` is absent), or is restricted. A note read before its date is `NOTE_NOT_YET_AVAILABLE`.

409.description: The idempotency key was already used for a different request (`details.reason` is `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`).

422.description: The request contains invalid values. `details.reason` is `DELIVER_ON_OUT_OF_RANGE` when the date is not from tomorrow (Auckland) up to 10 years ahead.

503.description: Future-self note storage is temporarily unavailable.

get.summary: List your future-self notes
get.description: Returns the caller's own notes, soonest delivery date first. Each item shows that the note exists, its date and its status, but never its text: read one note to get its text once its date has arrived.

200.description: One page of the caller's notes, without text.

403.description: The account has not chosen a username (`details.reason` is absent), or is restricted. A note read before its date is `NOTE_NOT_YET_AVAILABLE`.

422.description: The request contains invalid values. `details.reason` is `DELIVER_ON_OUT_OF_RANGE` when the date is not from tomorrow (Auckland) up to 10 years ahead.

503.description: Future-self note storage is temporarily unavailable.

get.summary: Read a future-self note
get.description: Returns the note's text to its owner from its Auckland delivery date onward, whether or not the delivery job has run. Before that date the response is `403` with `details.reason` `NOTE_NOT_YET_AVAILABLE` and no text. Anyone else, and an unknown ID, gets `404`.

403.description: The account has not chosen a username (`details.reason` is absent), or is restricted. A note read before its date is `NOTE_NOT_YET_AVAILABLE`.

404.description: The note does not exist or is not yours.

503.description: Future-self note storage is temporarily unavailable.

patch.description: Changes the text, the delivery date, or both, until the note is delivered. A new date follows the create rules and replaces any delivery already queued for the old one. A delivered note returns `409` with `details.reason` `NOTE_ALREADY_DELIVERED`. The response never includes the text.

200.description: The updated note without its text.

403.description: The account has not chosen a username (`details.reason` is absent), or is restricted. A note read before its date is `NOTE_NOT_YET_AVAILABLE`.

404.description: The note does not exist or is not yours.

409.description: The note is already delivered (`details.reason` is `NOTE_ALREADY_DELIVERED`).

422.description: The request contains invalid values. `details.reason` is `DELIVER_ON_OUT_OF_RANGE` when the date is not from tomorrow (Auckland) up to 10 years ahead.

503.description: Future-self note storage is temporarily unavailable.

delete.description: Deletes the caller's own note, scheduled or delivered, together with any queued delivery. An unknown ID or someone else's note returns `404`.

403.description: The account has not chosen a username (`details.reason` is absent), or is restricted. A note read before its date is `NOTE_NOT_YET_AVAILABLE`.

404.description: The note does not exist or is not yours.

503.description: Future-self note storage is temporarily unavailable.

get.summary: Get username setup state

200.description: The authenticated account's public identity state.

409.description: The username is already claimed or this account has completed setup.

post.summary: Claim an initial username
post.description: Completes the one-time required username setup for the authenticated account. It never renames an established handle.

409.description: The username is already claimed or this account has completed setup.

put.description: Changes an established username. It can change at most once every 30 days. The previous handle stays reserved for this account for 30 days, and profile links to it resolve to the new one. Choosing the current handle again changes nothing.

409.description: The username is taken or reserved (`details.reason = "taken"`), the last change was under 30 days ago (`details.reason = "tooSoon"` with `details.availableAt`), or the account has not chosen a username yet (`details.reason = "needsUsername"`).

get.summary: Read a profile's details
get.description: Returns anonymous-safe basics for a public account, the normal authorized profile to its owner or an active friend, or exactly the username and a generic restricted state for a private account. Unknown, inactive, banned, and blocked profiles all return 404.

200.description: The readable or restricted profile projection.

404.description: The profile does not exist or is blocked in either direction. The cases are indistinguishable.

get.summary: Read a currently authorized profile avatar
get.description: Rechecks current profile visibility and blocks on every request, then streams the private object without exposing a provider URL or object key.

304.description: The authorized representation has not changed.

404.description: The avatar is absent or its current profile is not readable.

412.description: An authorized conditional request precondition failed. The response has no provider body.

416.description: The requested byte range is not satisfiable. The response has no provider body.

patch.description: Changes any of the bio, public name, profile visibility, MBTI, what you do, and what you are listening to for the authenticated account. Fields left out are unchanged; null or blank text clears a field.

200.description: The updated profile, as its owner sees it.

409.description: The account has not chosen a username yet.

put.description: Uses one of your validated JPEG, PNG, or WebP uploads as your profile photo, replacing any previous one. Upload it first through the media reservation flow.

200.description: The profile with its new photo, as its owner sees it.

404.description: The upload does not exist or is not yours. The cases are indistinguishable.

409.description: The upload has not been validated (`details.reason = "notReady"`), is not a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image (`"notImage"`), or the account has no username yet (`"needsUsername"`).

delete.description: Removes the profile photo. Profiles then show the first letter of the name.

200.description: The profile without a photo, as its owner sees it.

409.description: The account has not chosen a username yet.
